_about: The travel document (I-131) packet (src/packet.py, src/travel.py), per the I-131 Instructions (01/20/25): the G-28 and the I-131, a copy of a government photo ID, and the document it is based on. The I-485 or I-589 receipt notice (advance parole), the asylum approval or I-94 (refugee travel document), the green card (reentry permit). Two passport photos for advance parole, or a refugee travel document filed from abroad. The attorney approves titles and order.
title: I-131 application (travel document)
requires_message: The client hasn't been processed yet: process the client first.

handwork.text: Advance parole (or a refugee travel document filed from outside the U.S.): two identical color passport-style photos, name and A-Number lightly in pencil on the back. A reentry permit or a refugee travel document filed from the U.S.: none (biometrics appointment).
Tell the client: no travel until the document is approved and in hand (and, for a reentry permit or refugee travel document, until biometrics are done).

exhibits.title: Government-issued photo identification (passport, driver's license, green card or work permit)
The basis: the I-485 or I-589 receipt notice, the asylum approval, or the green card
Evidence for the trip (e.g. a letter explaining an urgent or humanitarian reason)
